extraction.Name: Mary Whiting (Dec'd)
extraction.Refused/Protested: She told us she did not [ask for that patent]
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: It was first mortgaged for $9000 and the assignee of the mortgage got a deed from our father only a few days before he died.
extraction.NOTES: Mary Whiting died October 1918; never married, no children; parents Edward L. Whiting (died January 30, 1923) and Mary Whiting (died January 12, 1925) were heirs; estate was probated; mortgage of $9000 placed on land by parents; parents believed they were to receive $16,000; assignee of mortgage obtained deed from father shortly before his death; mother (Mary Whiting senior) could not read nor write and signed by thumb mark; some notes with father's name typewritten alleged to have been brought out for collection after father's death; deponents are siblings Thomas Whiting (age 36) and Hattie Whitcher (age 47); questionnaire sworn before Notary Public Jas. W. Cross on May 13, 1929; commission expires 4-28-32; possible fraud noted regarding bank obligations and Mr. Woods
